goal: Retention policy check: data kept for the stated period and deleted when it expires.
use: Retention policy check: data kept for the stated period and deleted when it expires. Use when data is stored, archived or backed up.

steps.note: List the data stores and their retention rules.
Check the periods. Each store has a stated retention period.
Check deletion. Flag stores with no delete path.
Check backups. Note how long backups keep deleted data.
Report. Each store with its period, its delete path and the gap.
